ValidationRule.description: Prevents users outside the BIC Standard User - Quoting profile from reopening a Closed/Cancelled Quote Request. If this profile is ever renamed, update the formula below.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Status__c ), OR( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Closed - Sent to customer" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Customer/Sales Requested" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled – production cannot produce" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled - Pricing available on internal website" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled - Not meeting MOQ" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled - In hands cannot be met" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled - Duplicate" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled - No Response" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled - Sent to Wrong Department" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled – not enough info submitted/invalid" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled - By Customer/Sales Rep" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled - Miscellaneous" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled - Production Cannot Produce" ) ), $Profile.Name <> "BIC Standard User - Quoting", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the Quoting Team can reopen a closed Quote Request. Please contact the Quoting Team if this record needs to be reopened.
